prerequisites: The second part of the study must be reached (at least 42 ECTS credits from the first part of the study must be demonstrated).
Knowledge of C or C++ programming or another system programming language

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the structure and architecture of current single-core and multi-core processors.
Map applications and algorithms to parallel computing units.
Identify and resolve conflicts in parallel programming.
Apply standard techniques for synchronizing processes and threads specifically to parallel programming problems.
Optimize applications for a given system.

syllabus_topics: Computer architectures and computational models of parallel computers
